sot23_5_pinout_trap_matrix.comparison_summary: Wave 2A introduces TWO critical SOT-23-5 (DBV) cross-reference hazards against the Pilot single op-amps (TLV9001IDBVR, TLV9061IDBVR, OPA333AIDBVR): (1) LMV321IDBVR uses the permuted LMV321/SC-70 SOT-23-5 pinout (1=1IN+, 2=GND, 3=1IN-, 4=OUT, 5=VCC+), swapping pins 1, 3, and 4 relative to TLV9001IDBVR/TLV9061IDBVR/OPA333AIDBVR (1=OUT, 2=V-, 3=IN+, 4=IN-, 5=V+)—making direct replacement a hard pinout mismatch (must use TI 'U' suffix variants like TLV9001UIDBVR); (2) TLV3201AIDBVR shares the exact same SOT-23-5 pinout as TLV9001IDBVR/TLV9061IDBVR/OPA333AIDBVR (1=OUT, 2=GND, 3=IN+, 4=IN-, 5=VCC), creating a single-channel SOT-23-5 equivalent of the classic SOIC-8 LM358 vs LM393 op-amp/comparator confusion trap!

parts.key_trap: Permuted pins 1/3/4 vs TLV9001IDBVR/TLV9061IDBVR/OPA333AIDBVR/TLV3201AIDBVR; zero supply headroom above 5.5 V (abs max = 5.5 V); non-RRI upper input limit (VCC+ - 1.0 V).

Pin-identical in SOT-23-5 to linear op-amps TLV9001IDBVR/TLV9061IDBVR/OPA333AIDBVR, but is an uncompensated 43 ns push-pull comparator (oscillates in linear negative feedback); push-pull output must NOT be wired-AND or pulled up to another rail; incompatible with LMV321IDBVR pinout.

soic8_dual_opamp_traps.trap: TI Rev K (December 2025, SLOS075K) reduced NE5532DR Abs Max supply from ±22 V (44 V) down to ±18 V (36 V), reduced typical slew rate from 9 V/µs down to 5 V/µs, reduced total ICC from 8 mA to 6 mA (3 mA/ch), raised GBW from 10 MHz to 12 MHz, and lowered HBM ESD from 2000 V to 1000 V—while legacy prose in Sections 6.3 and 7.2 still cites older numbers. Also features anti-parallel input clamp diodes conducting above ~0.6 V differential (abs max ±10 mA) and Commercial 0°C–70°C rating (vs SA5532DR -40°C–85°C).

Strict 6.0 V abs max supply (destructive in 12 V/24 V LM358 or ±15 V TL072/NE5532 SOIC-8 boards), 9x higher Iq (538 µA/ch typ; ~1.08 mA total) than TLV9002IDR, and 10 MHz bandwidth requiring tight 0.1 µF decoupling and RISO for CL > 100 pF.

Weak ±5 mA short-circuit drive, 2 kΩ open-loop output impedance, 350 kHz GBWP, and 0.16 V/µs slew rate despite sharing the exact SOIC-8 pinout with fast/high-drive TLV9002IDR, TLV9062IDR, and LMV358IDR. Also has ±70 pA chopper bias pulses and ±1 mA abs max signal input current.

unit_and_normalization_checks: All input bias currents strictly normalized to pA: TLV9062IDR = 0.5 pA, OPA2333AIDR = 70 pA, LMV321IDBVR = 15000 pA (15 nA), NE5532DR = 200000 pA (200 nA), TLV3201AIDBVR = 1 pA.

All quiescent currents strictly normalized per channel (iq_per_ch_typ_ua): TLV9062IDR = 538 µA/ch (per-amp table), OPA2333AIDR = 17 µA/ch (per-amp table), LMV321IDBVR = 130 µA/ch (single-ch LMV321I at 5 V), NE5532DR = 3000 µA/ch (derived from 6 mA typ total dual ICC / 2), TLV3201AIDBVR = 40 µA/ch (single comparator at 5 V).
OPA2333AIDR converted cleanly: VOS max 10 µV -> 0.01 mV, GBWP 350 kHz -> 0.35 MHz; RθJA = 124.0 °C/W read from OPA2333 Section 6.5 (not single OPA333 Section 6.4 = 140.1 °C/W).

TLV3201AIDBVR verified as active push-pull CMOS comparator (output_type='push-pull') with VIO-TLV3201 = 3 mV max (distinct from TLV3202 5 mV) and tPD = 43 ns typ L-to-H (42 ns H-to-L) at VCC = 5 V, 100 mV overdrive, CL = 15 pF (47/45 ns at 20 mV OD, 50 ns max at 25°C, 40 ns headline).
